add.name: Sky_high_window
add.note: window_high at (-20.25,10,35), identity rotation/scale. Upper octagonal opening has bounds about +/-1.15. polySurface5 translates +5.5 m, placing its pane at world y14.954888 (mesh y-.545112). castlebase_wall_windows is opaque SolidDiffuse with illumination, no Alpha/transparency: place sky 5.5 cm below the pane on the interior side so its light enters the real shaft. The 1.6 m square fits inside the octagon; preserve scripted map-wide cyan/amber box states.
